items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's where Charlotte and Tessie lived.

ctx.x: That's right. Jamaica Track was there. That's where Charlotte and Tessie lived. They tore that track down and built them buildings, condominiums in a big apartment building when you buy them. That's where they lived, right where Jamaica Track was. But over where I lived was near Jamaica Avenue, or Jamaica. That's where these guys had all their homes.
